lines.zh: 我在 y 负二十以下游，光懒得下来。
lines.en: I swim below y minus twenty, where light won't descend.

lines.zh: 头顶的灯一晃，黑暗就退开一点。
lines.en: My lamp sways, and the dark steps back a little.

lines.zh: 尾鳍轻轻摆，岩石边就静了。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and the rocks go quiet.

lines.zh: 深水里没有浪，我推着自己走。
lines.en: No waves this deep; I push myself along.

lines.zh: 我沿着水底的裂缝巡游。
lines.en: I patrol along the cracks of the seabed.

lines.zh: 同类在远处，我跟着它们的影子。
lines.en: My kin are far off; I follow their shadows.

lines.zh: 再深一点，就没人知道我了。
lines.en: A little deeper, and no one knows I exist.

lines.zh: 灯光扫过石壁，我看见了路。
lines.en: My light sweeps the stone wall and finds the way.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，像在数水滴。
lines.en: I swim slowly, as if counting water drops.

lines.zh: 冷水贴住身体，比岸边舒服。
lines.en: Cold water hugs my body, kinder than the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的鳍擦过沉船的木刺。
lines.en: My fin brushes splinters of a sunken wreck.

lines.zh: 灯亮在最前，我走在最后。
lines.en: The lamp leads at the front, and I trail behind.

lines.zh: 往上一点就太亮了，我转身。
lines.en: Any higher is too bright, so I turn away.

lines.zh: 水压压着我的背，我习惯了。
lines.en: Pressure presses on my back, and I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我游过一段没有名的水沟。
lines.en: I swim through a nameless trench.

lines.zh: 灯照到的地方，石头是灰的。
lines.en: Where my lamp reaches, the stone is grey.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块塌下来的岩壁。
lines.en: I round a slab of fallen rock.

lines.zh: 再往下，连水声都没有。
lines.en: Deeper still, even the water goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我悬在那里，灯一亮一暗。
lines.en: I hang there, my lamp brightening and dimming.

lines.zh: 深海里，等也是一种游法。
lines.en: Down here, waiting is also a way to swim.

lines.zh: 诱饵晃着，没有鱼上钩。
lines.en: My lure sways, and nothing takes the bait.

lines.zh: 我的牙向外长，合不上嘴。
lines.en: My teeth grow outward; my mouth never closes.

lines.zh: 二十厘米的身子，也算罕见。
lines.en: Twenty centimeters of me counts as rare.

lines.zh: 水底的石缝里，我数着气泡。
lines.en: In a crevice, I count the rising bubbles.

lines.zh: 灯是我的，谁也抢不走。
lines.en: The lamp is mine; no one takes it.

lines.zh: 我沉在沙上，像一块黑布。
lines.en: I settle on the sand like a scrap of black cloth.

lines.zh: 上面有声响，我懒得上去。
lines.en: There is noise above; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 深渊里没有季节，只有冷。
lines.en: No seasons in the abyss, only cold.

lines.zh: 我的鳃慢慢开合，像在算什么。
lines.en: My gills open slowly, as if calculating.

lines.zh: 大个子的影子过去，我没动。
lines.en: Something huge passed by, and I did not move.

lines.zh: 七十厘米是记录，我才二十。
lines.en: Seventy centimeters is the record; I am twenty.

lines.zh: 灯照见自己的牙，有点好笑。
lines.en: My lamp lights my own teeth; a little funny.

lines.zh: 你潜这么深，是想看我的灯吗？
lines.en: You dove this deep just to see my lamp?

lines.zh: 别用手抓，我滑得很。
lines.en: Don't grab me with your hands; I'm slippery.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸泡吓走了我的同类。
lines.en: Your breath bubbles scared off my kin.

lines.zh: 我在下面看你，你在上面找我。
lines.en: I watch you below while you search above.

lines.zh: 灯照你脸，你眯起眼睛。
lines.en: My lamp hits your face, and you squint.

lines.zh: 水里这么暗，你居然看得见我。
lines.en: It's dark down here, yet you spotted me.

lines.zh: 你把头灯关了，我更喜欢。
lines.en: You turned off your helmet light; I prefer that.

lines.zh: 再靠近，灯就照进你眼睛。
lines.en: Come closer, and my lamp fills your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身边的鱼都比我会游。
lines.en: The fish beside you all swim better than I do.

lines.zh: 我知道你在数我的牙。
lines.en: I know you are counting my teeth.

lines.zh: 鱼线一拉，我的灯晃得厉害。
lines.en: The line jerks, and my lamp swings wildly.

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，我的灯灭了半秒。
lines.en: Something hits me and my lamp dies for half a second.

lines.zh: 谁在深水里打我？我看不见。
lines.en: Who strikes me this deep? I cannot see.

lines.zh: 我的鳍被咬掉一小块。
lines.en: A piece of my fin is bitten off.

lines.zh: 疼得我在原地打转。
lines.en: It hurts so much I spin in place.

lines.zh: 冷水灌进伤口，反而舒服些。
lines.en: Cold water fills the wound and it actually soothes.

lines.zh: 我往石缝里缩，灯也调暗了。
lines.en: I shrink into a crevice and dim my lamp.

lines.zh: 这层水太深，没人会来帮我。
lines.en: This layer is too deep for anyone to help me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片掉了几片，飘走了。
lines.en: A few scales come loose and drift away.

lines.zh: 别打我的灯，那是我的眼睛。
lines.en: Not the lamp; that is my eye.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里流血，我闻到了。
lines.en: Something is bleeding in the water; I smell it.

lines.zh: 你挂着的那块肉，晃得很好看。
lines.en: That meat on your hook sways beautifully.

lines.zh: 灯下的浮游生物，够我吃一天。
lines.en: The plankton under my light feeds me all day.

lines.zh: 再来一条小鱼，我就动身。
lines.en: One more small fish, and I'll come over.

lines.zh: 生的鱼肉，比什么都近。
lines.en: Raw fish is the closest thing to a treat.

lines.zh: 你手里有虫，我看见了。
lines.en: There are worms in your hand; I saw them.

lines.zh: 火把别靠近水面，我怕热。
lines.en: Keep the torch from the water; I hate heat.

lines.zh: 你把灯伸过来，我就跟上。
lines.en: Hold your lamp closer, and I'll follow it.

lines.zh: 这味道是从你的桶里来的。
lines.en: That smell is coming from your bucket.

lines.zh: 饿了几天的深渊，容易上当。
lines.en: An abyss that starved for days falls for bait.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，水纹乱成一片。
lines.en: You bump me, and the ripples scatter.

lines.zh: 我的身体很薄，别压。
lines.en: I am thin; please don't press on me.

lines.zh: 灯晃了一下，你的影子也晃了。
lines.en: My lamp jolts, and so does your shadow.

lines.zh: 你游得太急，撞碎了气泡。
lines.en: You swim too fast and burst the bubbles.

lines.zh: 我滑过你的护腿，像摸过一块石。
lines.en: I slide past your leggings like brushing stone.

lines.zh: 半格宽的身子，也能挡你一下。
lines.en: Half a block of fish can still stop you.

lines.zh: 别用手推，你会抓到我的牙。
lines.en: Don't shove me; you'll catch my teeth.

lines.zh: 水动了一下，我的同类全跑了。
lines.en: The water stirred, and all my kin fled.

lines.zh: 这一碰，惊得我灯都灭了。
lines.en: That bump startled me so my lamp went dark.

lines.zh: 你踩到底了，我就在你脚边。
lines.en: You touched bottom; I am right by your feet.

lines.zh: 深水里，另一盏灯也在亮。
lines.en: Deeper down, another lamp is also glowing.

lines.zh: 我的同类瘦，但灯一样闪。
lines.en: My kin are thin, but their lamps flash the same.

lines.zh: 两条鮟鱇绕着石柱转。
lines.en: Two anglers circle the same stone pillar.

lines.zh: 繁殖期没人看，深渊更安静。
lines.en: No one watches the spawning season; the deep is quieter.

lines.zh: 我跟着它的灯，游了很远。
lines.en: I followed its lamp for a long way.

lines.zh: 同类很少，遇见就要记着。
lines.en: Kin are scarce; when we meet, we remember.

lines.zh: 我们的牙太长，亲吻要小心。
lines.en: Our teeth are long, so kissing takes care.

lines.zh: 两条细影并排，沉进更深处。
lines.en: Two thin shadows sink deeper, side by side.

lines.zh: 它的灯比我的暗，我让着它。
lines.en: Its lamp is dimmer than mine; I let it lead.

lines.zh: 深海的爱，只是并肩游一段。
lines.en: Deep-sea love is simply swimming side by side.

lines.zh: 桶里有水就够了，我不挑地方。
lines.en: A bucket with water is enough; I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 你要装我，先别晃那个桶。
lines.en: If you're bucketing me, stop sloshing that thing.

lines.zh: 我太滑，你的手抓不住。
lines.en: I'm too slippery for your hands to hold.

lines.zh: 沉下去容易，提起来很轻。
lines.en: Going down is easy; lifting me is light work.

lines.zh: 别把我跟别的鱼装一起。
lines.en: Don't put me in with the other fish.

lines.zh: 桶底太亮，我用鳍挡着眼。
lines.en: The bucket bottom is too bright; I shade my eyes.

lines.zh: 你提着桶走，我在里面数步子。
lines.en: You carry me along; inside I count your steps.

lines.zh: 水没了，我就只剩一张嘴。
lines.en: Take away the water and I'm just a mouth.

lines.zh: 放回深水，我会记着你。
lines.en: Return me to deep water and I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，桶盖挡不住。
lines.en: My lamp still glows; the bucket lid can't hide it.

lines.zh: 你手指在水里晃，我咬定了。
lines.en: Your fingers wiggle in the water; I'm on them.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼先动，我就追它。
lines.en: That small fish moved first, so I chase it.

lines.zh: 有血味，方向就清楚了。
lines.en: There's blood in the water, and the direction is clear.

lines.zh: 我不大，但牙齿够用。
lines.en: I am small, but my teeth are enough.

lines.zh: 目标就在灯能照到的地方。
lines.en: My target is wherever my lamp can reach.

lines.zh: 你踢起的水花，暴露了自己。
lines.en: Your splashing gave away where you are.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是那块肉，不是你。
lines.en: I'm after that meat, not you.

lines.zh: 别把手垂在水里，我在看。
lines.en: Don't dangle your hand; I am watching it.

lines.zh: 深渊里，任何动静都是猎物。
lines.en: Down here, any movement counts as prey.

lines.zh: 我游向你，灯先到。
lines.en: I swim toward you, and my lamp arrives first.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下游，你没发现。
lines.en: I circle beneath your feet, unnoticed.

lines.zh: 灯靠近了，你的影子在缩。
lines.en: My lamp draws near and your shadow shrinks.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就踩到我。
lines.en: One more step back, and you'll step on me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，等一个空档。
lines.en: I circle you, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 水草挡路，我从缝里钻。
lines.en: The kelp is in the way; I slip through a gap.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里，很显眼。
lines.en: Your legs stand out clearly in the water.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的靴带，不松。
lines.en: I've got your bootlace and won't let go.

lines.zh: 石缝里有我的位置，慢慢来。
lines.en: There's a crevice with my name; take it slow.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就换个角度。
lines.en: You turn, and I shift to another angle.

lines.zh: 别急，我游不过你的。
lines.en: Don't rush; I can't outswim you anyway.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的指尖，就一下。
lines.en: I nip your fingertip, just once.

lines.zh: 牙划过去，水里多了点红。
lines.en: My teeth rake past, and the water turns red.

lines.zh: 只咬破一点皮，你却忘不掉。
lines.en: It only breaks the skin, yet you won't forget.

lines.zh: 我咬的是鱼饵，不是你的手。
lines.en: I was biting the bait, not your hand.

lines.zh: 灯一闪，你缩手，我咬空了。
lines.en: My lamp flashed; you pulled back and I missed.

lines.zh: 四点的生命，也敢咬你。
lines.en: Four points of health, and I still bite you.

lines.zh: 别甩手，牙齿挂住了。
lines.en: Don't shake your hand; my teeth caught on.

lines.zh: 血味散开，同类都围过来了。
lines.en: The blood spreads, and my kin gather around.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，躲回石缝。
lines.en: I bite, then retreat into my crevice.

lines.zh: 你太小看一条二十厘米的鱼。
lines.en: You underestimated a twenty-centimeter fish.

lines.zh: 地下水域里，我的灯先亮起来。
lines.en: In the underground water, my lamp lights first.

lines.zh: 地下负二十层以下，我找到缝隙。
lines.en: Below minus twenty, I found a crevice.

lines.zh: 主世界的水域，也藏着深渊。
lines.en: Even Overworld waters hide an abyss.

lines.zh: 我是罕见的一个，别声张。
lines.en: I am a rare one; keep it quiet.

lines.zh: 灯在水里亮，像一颗小星星。
lines.en: My lamp glows underwater like a small star.

lines.zh: 水底的黑暗里，我出生了。
lines.en: I was born in the darkness of the seabed.

lines.zh: 这次只有我一条，没成群。
lines.en: This time I came alone, with no school.

lines.zh: 头顶的灯，是我带来的第一束光。
lines.en: The lamp above me brought the first light here.

lines.zh: 沙粒落下来，盖住了我的尾。
lines.en: Sand settles and covers my tail.

lines.zh: 深水里响了一下，那是我来了。
lines.en: Something stirred in the deep; that was me.

lines.zh: 火一碰我，我就熟了，真熟了。
lines.en: Fire touches me and I cook, quite literally.

lines.zh: 摔在石头上，我的灯暗了一下。
lines.en: I hit the stone, and my lamp flickers.

lines.zh: 我就在水里，怎么会被淹？
lines.en: I live in water; how can I drown?

lines.zh: 炸开的水泡推着我撞上岩壁。
lines.en: The blast's bubbles shove me into the wall.

lines.zh: 箭穿过来，水放慢了它。
lines.en: An arrow comes through; the water slows it.

lines.zh: 魔法在深水里散成一圈光。
lines.en: Magic dissolves into a ring of light.

lines.zh: 灯再亮，也照不出食物。
lines.en: However bright my lamp, it can't find food.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I shudder.

lines.zh: 虚空的冷，比深渊还深。
lines.en: Void cold runs deeper than the abyss.
